project.name: Worth Touched Graph Milestone 15 Planner Owned Routing Public Proof And Diagnostics

phases.title: Public Proof, Diagnostic, And Explainer Inventory Cut Line
acceptance: every covered public proof, explainer, and diagnostic surface has an exact inventory row with migrate, delete, cap, or Query-gap posture
inventory rows classify each surface as prior-proof consumer, family-route product, selected-route consumer, public-proof projection, derived-diagnostic projection, or forbidden legacy explainer
inventory rows name the exact new parallel folder lane that will replace the displaced surface
phases.instructions: Freeze every current receipt-backed status, public closeout, diagnostic, explainer, and route-localization surface before introducing replacement lanes.
phases.qa_focus: No grep-only theater, no vague grouped rows, and no unnamed current public-proof lane hidden behind polished existing helpers.

phases.title: Shared Planner-Owned Explanation Vocabulary
acceptance: shared contracts distinguish selected route identity, selected product identity, witness identity, decision-trace identity, public-proof identity, and diagnostic contract identity
rendered strings and lower-authority report rows cannot mint planner-owned explanation artifacts
the shared vocabulary preserves authority versus derivation semantics for planner packets, public proof, and diagnostics
phases.instructions: Land one shared contract lane for route explanation identity before any family tries to explain itself locally.
phases.qa_focus: Shared ownership only, no crate-local sameness ontologies, and no collapsing of route, product, and public-proof identities.

phases.title: Planner Route Trace And Public-Proof Input Packet
acceptance: a sealed selected-route packet carries prior-proof identities, selected route identity, selected family and product identity, witness identity, Query posture where applicable, and residue or firewall references
public proof can assemble from the selected-route packet without reopening topology, evidence, or reuse internals
later phases consume the same packet rather than rebuilding a second packet from the same facts
phases.instructions: Create the planner-owned route packet that later execution, public proof, and diagnostics all consume unchanged.
phases.qa_focus: No executor-side reconstruction, no projection formatting mixed into selection logic, and no second packet minted downstream.

phases.title: Query-Backed Read Routing Explanation Lane
acceptance: query-backed route explanation consumes admitted Query support posture and boundary evidence rather than Worth-local support folklore
foreign or mismatched Query posture cannot satisfy the selected route packet
ordinary route logic lives under a new planner-owned routing lane rather than continuing in query_backed_consumer_cutover
phases.instructions: Move query-backed read-family explanation out of local closeout and read-model helpers into a dedicated planner-consumable route lane.
phases.qa_focus: Real Query artifacts only, no Worth-local summary enums, and no in-place continuation inside legacy closeout folders.

phases.title: Invalidation Route Input Lane
acceptance: planner input preserves exact touched fact identity, aspect scope, and selected invalidation family
report rows alone cannot mint invalidation route input
invalidation explanation becomes a typed planner input rather than a local report reconstruction
phases.instructions: Make invalidation explanation consumable as typed planner inputs instead of local report reconstruction.
phases.qa_focus: Exact touched scope retention, no broad summary collapse, and no projection rows promoted to authority.

phases.title: Derived-Read Diagnostic Input Lane
acceptance: diagnostic inputs preserve touched fact identity, aspect scope, selected route identity, and selected family
diagnostic inputs require real invalidation and selected-route products
route-input construction stays separate from human-facing projection formatting
phases.instructions: Build the derived-read diagnostic input lane as a separate consumer of prior planner and invalidation products instead of mixing it with invalidation-route authority.
phases.qa_focus: No authority drift into diagnostics and no merged route-localization formatter lane.

phases.title: Evidence Lookup Route Lane
acceptance: evidence lookup route explanation consumes milestone 14 products without rescanning evidence rows
denial localizes exact route mismatch rather than broad lookup failure
the evidence lookup route-authority lane closes before public closeout projection
phases.instructions: Move evidence lookup explanation onto the planner-owned route vocabulary instead of crate-local closeout assembly.
phases.qa_focus: No retained-product folklore, no evidence rows as explanation authority, and no merged counter semantics.

phases.title: Spatial Public-Closeout Route Lane
acceptance: spatial public closeout proves selected family, selected product, and reuse posture from planner route products without rescanning evidence rows
denial localizes exact family or support mismatch rather than broad lookup failure
ordinary-path explanation moves into a new planner-owned routing lane instead of current-source assembly
phases.instructions: Move spatial public-closeout explanation onto the planner-owned route vocabulary instead of crate-local current-source assembly.
phases.qa_focus: No current-source linger, no local retained semantics reopening, and no ordinary-path logic added under displaced assembler folders.

phases.title: Replay, Undo, And Transaction Explanation Route Lane
acceptance: execution and public proof both consume the same replay or undo route product
foreign or stale replay-scope packets deny before public proof assembly
transaction and undo explanation remain distinct planner route families
phases.instructions: Lower replay, undo, and transaction-scope explanation into planner-consumable route products so no caller or executor reclassifies scope semantics locally.
phases.qa_focus: No same-scope folklore, no helper-summary reconstruction, and no folding of transaction meaning into generic diagnostic text.

phases.title: Conflict And Independence Route Lane
acceptance: conflict and independence explanation share the same selected route chain
diagnostics distinguish conflict-route denial from independence denial with typed witness identity
public proof does not reinvent grouped conflict meaning from operator shape or row overlap
phases.instructions: Lower conflict and independence meaning into planner-consumable route products without letting public proof or diagnostics rebuild grouped-routing semantics locally.
phases.qa_focus: No generic blocked posture collapse and no second local grouped-routing ontology.

phases.title: Batch-Admission Route Lane
acceptance: batch explanation binds selected route identity and batch-admission identity together
diagnostics distinguish batch denial from conflict or independence denial with separate witness identity
batch-admission explanation remains a separate family-route lane
phases.instructions: Lower batch-admission meaning into its own planner-consumable route products instead of treating it as a side-effect of conflict explanation.
phases.qa_focus: No batch piggybacking on conflict wording and no reconstruction from executor-local bookkeeping.

phases.title: Compiled-Product Reuse Explanation Route Lane
acceptance: public proof and diagnostics explain reuse, rebuild, or denial from typed milestone 14 products only
compatibility-without-reuse stays distinct from successful reuse
public proof does not compare rendered outputs or helper summaries to explain reuse
phases.instructions: Lower compiled-product reuse, rebuild-required, compatibility-without-reuse, and denial posture into planner-consumable route meaning instead of reopening milestone 14 cache or equivalence logic locally.
phases.qa_focus: No local cache folklore and no silent promotion of compatibility-without-reuse into reuse.

phases.title: Planner-Owned Public Proof Assembly Lane
acceptance: public proof assembly fails if covered meaning is provided as local report data instead of a planner-owned route product
foreign route, firewall, or residue identities cannot be combined into a plausible public proof
public proof remains a derived artifact-policy consumer rather than a new planning lane
phases.instructions: Build the public proof lane as a dedicated derived assembly boundary that consumes selected route packets and family route products only.
phases.qa_focus: No raw constructor input, no route-policy decisions inside public proof, and no mixing of proof assembly with facade export or diagnostics formatting.

phases.title: Derived Diagnostic Projection Lane
acceptance: diagnostics localize exact selected family, selected product, touched or aspect scope, witness identity, and denial posture
artifact policy can suppress rich diagnostics without losing minimal operational truth
diagnostics remain derived projections rather than the sole carrier of machine denial truth
phases.instructions: Build a separate planner-owned derived diagnostics lane that localizes exact route meaning without becoming the authority for that meaning.
phases.qa_focus: No diagnostic authority drift, no merged human-facing formatting with machine identity, and no broad labels where exact mismatch data exists.

phases.title: Public Read-Only Facade Boundary
acceptance: callers can inspect proof and diagnostics but cannot construct planner route or proof products
public callers cannot satisfy the facade through support wrappers, raw rows, or local explainer helpers
public facade files aggregate but do not implement route policy
phases.instructions: Expose planner-owned proof and diagnostics through a narrow public facade that allows inspection but not fabrication, mutation, or route-local rediscovery.
phases.qa_focus: No raw planner constructors, no test-only shortcut exports, and no mirror of internal directory topology on the public facade.

phases.title: Kernel Public-Closeout Cutover
acceptance: covered public-closeout entry points fail if planner-owned route products are absent and cannot silently reopen legacy helper logic
no covered ordinary kernel public-closeout helper lane remains outside the planner-owned cutover or explicit residue ledger
ordinary callers cut imports to new planner-owned lanes instead of continuing to author behavior under legacy public_closeout modules
phases.instructions: Cut kernel public-closeout callers from mixed local closeout helpers onto the planner-owned proof and diagnostics lanes.
phases.qa_focus: No wrapper-based pseudo-cutover, no current-source continuation, and no legacy public-closeout helper left as the real ordinary authority path.

phases.title: Workload-Composition Explainer Cutover
acceptance: workload-composition explanation surfaces import planner-owned proof or diagnostic lanes directly
no ordinary workload-composition explainer surface remains outside the new lane or explicit residue ledger
kernel workload-composition explainer debt is counted independently from public-closeout debt
phases.instructions: Cut workload-composition explainers and route-local status surfaces off legacy kernel helper lanes and onto planner-owned proof or diagnostic imports.
phases.qa_focus: No second local explanation language after cutover and no route-local status helpers kept as harmless convenience.

phases.title: Topology Explainer Cutover
acceptance: ordinary topology callers resolve through the new planner-owned route lanes instead of displaced legacy modules
compile-fail or source firewall proof rejects imports of displaced topology explainer and closeout helper lanes
topology cutover happens through real parallel folders and named new imports
phases.instructions: Cut topology callers off displaced local explainers, report builders, and closeout-local route logic, then delete or cap the old topo lanes.
phases.qa_focus: No in-place reshaping of legacy modules and no broad mixed topo lanes hidden as residue.

phases.title: Spatial Explainer Cutover And Hard Deletion
acceptance: ordinary spatial callers resolve through the new planner-owned route lanes instead of displaced legacy modules
compile-fail or source firewall proof rejects imports of displaced spatial explainer and closeout helper lanes
displaced spatial folders stop being the normal authoring home for route meaning
phases.instructions: Cut spatial callers off displaced local explainers and closeout-local route logic, then delete or cap the old spatial lanes.
phases.qa_focus: No current-source linger, no broad mixed spatial residue, and no pseudo-cutover that keeps old folders as ordinary path owners.

phases.title: Source Firewalls, Constructor Denials, And Compile-Fail Fences
acceptance: callers cannot fabricate planner route, public proof, or diagnostic authority from raw collections, strings, or copied digests
compile-fail fixtures reject imports of forbidden helper lanes, support wrappers, and route-local construction seams
constructor visibility forces covered callers through planner-owned admission or derived public facade lanes
phases.instructions: Seal the planner-owned route, proof, and diagnostics boundaries so local explanation ceremony cannot come back.
phases.qa_focus: No comments-as-firewalls, no test-only raw constructors left public, and no import firewall without a real replacement lane.

phases.title: Residue Ledger, Query-Gap Ledger, And Honest Public Debt
acceptance: every remaining unmigrated public or diagnostic surface is counted exactly with owner, blocker, and removal trigger
Query-backed support gaps are not mixed with Worth-local architecture residue
the ledger remains mechanically derivable from live surfaces rather than hand-edited prose
phases.instructions: Any public or diagnostic path not fully migrated must be explicit residue, explicit Query-gap, or deleted.
phases.qa_focus: No future-cleanup euphemisms, no hidden ordinary-path debt, and no false claims of Query support admission.

phases.title: Milestone 15 Closeout And Milestone 16 Handoff
acceptance: execution, public proof, and diagnostics consume the same planner-owned selected-route chain on at least one representative path
milestone 16 handoff products carry route identity, family identity, witness identity, residue posture, and Query posture without local rediscovery

final closeout proves the migration law was honored: new lanes created beside old ones, ordinary callers cut over, displaced lanes deleted or capped, and no ordinary path depends on local route rediscovery
phases.instructions: Close the milestone only when public proof and diagnostics are visibly derived from the same planner-owned route authority execution consumed, and emit the handoff products milestone 16 needs for cross-family parity.
phases.qa_focus: No closeout by polished diagnostics alone and no milestone 16 handoff that still requires rediscovery from helpers, rows, or strings.
